replay.note: Each match is re-simulated with the real XIs, batting order of appearance, each bowler's real share of the bowling by phase, the ground and the side that batted first. The ratings were fitted on these same matches, so this checks that the simulator turns per-ball probabilities into realistic matches. It is not evidence of predictive skill, and the win-probability table flatters the model for the same reason.

shock.note: Estimated on in-sample since 2019: 1040 innings, 928 cross-team innings pairs. Both sides of a match share a pitch and weather; the covariance of their residual scoring and wicket rates sizes a match-level shock on a scoring axis and a wicket axis, and what is left of the within-innings variance after sampling noise sizes an innings-level shock. Both are drawn in every simulated match.
